methodology: Chromium CDP response byte counts minus known headers, completed bodies capped at recorded Content-Length; cache/304 bodies count as zero. Pending or canceled media counts bytes observed by the snapshot and can undercount full buffering. Full referenced local source files are deduplicated separately by URL; external music is reported separately and included in network totals. These local server observations are not a measurement of the public host. Captures are cumulative; resources are aggregated per URL from the final snapshot.

captures.scope: fresh browser context, title and all automatic prefetch; NEW GAME opening; normal return to title in the same browser context with cache enabled; snapshots are cumulative.
captures.measurementNotes: Completed responses capped at their recorded Content-Length to exclude known protocol overhead. Raw cumulative byte counts before that correction are preserved per phase. Partial media is not expanded to the full file size.
